lines: 📺 MID-SHOW — the feed cuts away from the game. A pod, huge on the screen. A small face behind the glass, asleep. The System, syrup-sweet: "Look at them! NAPPING! The audience wants to know — what should WE do with them? ...Well? You're the Bearer. SAY something. The cameras are RIGHT here."
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
📡 The next act is still waiting — armor the village (1 of 4 fighters armored); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
— DAY 172 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"The System flagged your sector. Move. NOW."
(258 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
💬 Carmela mutters: "Smile for the sky, they said. I hate how easy it was to start doing it."
"Five wins. FIVE. The human is on a streak and the bookmakers are sweating."
Someone's bread rose twice as high this morning. The old ones say that's Carmela's doing. Nobody argues.
🏃 Aisha of Emberhold walks into Haven unannounced, pack-mules behind. "Heard your bins are echoing. Emberhold has grain to spare — 2,138 kcal, no tribute, no ceremony. Say the word."
(Aid offer — accept or refuse from the beats row. Refusing costs pride: trust -3.)
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 MAIN EVENT rules: the arena runs hotter tonight. You start this one already hurt — the galaxy loves an underdog. Especially a bleeding one.
📺 The billing said EXTREME RISK. The System doesn't pull its punches.
📺 You take 18 damage.

📺 Hardened The Box. An alien puzzle box. Solve it or be stuck inside the arena until you do. The audience has the manual. The rules have changed. The audience demanded it. Almost nobody walks away from this one. The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky. The box is bigger inside than out. That's the first problem. The audience has the manual. They are n
📺 You circle it, learning its logic. The audience gets restless. Restless is good — they start shouting hints.
📺 A panel slides open. Inside: a smaller box. Of course. The chat is spamming the solution. Half of them are lying.
📺 You follow the most-upvoted hint. It's either genius or sabotage. Fifty-fifty, televised.
📺 You take 14 damage.
📺 Last layer. The box is humming now — it knows you're close. One move left. The audience holds its breath.
📺 You see it — the pattern resolves like a chord. You move. The box OPENS. The crowd detonates.
📚 The Box: you know its beats now. The intro will tell you what you've learned.
📺 Hardened The Box — YOU WIN. The crowd is a weather system.
📈 your showbiz fans +8 — won Hardened The Box on camera (favor: 76)
📺 The System presses something humming into your hands: Phase blade. Phases through armor. The blade is only sometimes here.
📺 SYSTEM: "That thing you do — with the OTHER thing. The audience SAW it. Do it again. We want the third one on camera."
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
Something wants to happen when you do... whatever you just did. (2/3)
Catch the flicker. Then read what the room does with it.
📺 The lights take their cut. Winning marks you. (-5 health.)
📺 You won. Your hands won't stop shaking for a while. (+4 trauma.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Carmela — 💧 Fetch water. Carmela nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Equipped Phase blade (melee).

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — national standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/9/5), 22 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
💧 Carmela returns with 14L, but the cistern only holds 13L more.
You catch fragments by the fire — David telling Abdellah about Devon. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Devon heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably."
Carmela is working the cookpot, tasting, adjusting.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You don't know how to make a Arrow yet.
Carmela is working the cookpot, tasting, adjusting.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You don't know how to make a Arrow yet.
🌿 Devon returns from foraging the wilds: +512 kcal to the pantry.
💬 Mara is sitting with David, talking low. Not business. Just people.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Spotlight: The room is already warm. Audience starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)
◈ ABILITY — Standing-O: Genuine love doesn't crater: the audience can't fall below 0 while you hold it.
◈ ABILITY — Eulogy: The quiet ones' act lands harder than any headliner. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the variety finale: ONE NIGHT ONLY

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
Nino tells the hunt — the real one, with the fear left in. The audience goes silent in the good way. Silence, at this scale, is deafening.
The feast song — the one about eating like it matters, because it does. Trillions of beings who never ate anything hear it and feel hungry for the first time. The ratings spike is audible.

You spend it all — the love, the light, the finale slot — on people the cameras never found. You name the unfilmed villages. You name the dead. The audience weeps in eleven dimensions. This is what the show was for, it turns out.
◈ THE BELOVED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE BELOVED — "Let the audience speak."

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.
◈ Aidan Ahn walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in. The village endures. That was always the story.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.

💛 You hold Knife roll. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📋 Carmela — 🎣 Fish. Carmela nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Abdellah — 🍲 Cook. Abdellah nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
You accept Emberhold's food — 2,138 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Aisha clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
